Analytical and quantitatively-driven economist, completing a PhD, with 4 years of experience applying rigorous statistical analysis to complex market issues. Known for a proven ability to analyze market dynamics and competition policy, demonstrated through direct involvement in merger analysis and international trade disputes. Seeking to leverage advanced skills in econometrics, data visualization, and predictive modeling to deliver impactful insights on competition economics matters at Econic Partners.
